title: Example 1
text: ClaroIA helps compare summaries from multiple OpenAI-compatible models. It supports local and cloud endpoints, batch files, and rubric-based evaluation.
reference: ClaroIA compares summaries across OpenAI-compatible models with batch processing and rubric evaluation.

title: Example 2
text: The public demo uses bring-your-own-key mode. The backend validates allowed HTTPS endpoints and forwards requests without storing API keys.
reference: The demo is BYOK: it validates allowed HTTPS endpoints and does not store user API keys.
